verdict.rationale: Guided first-run onboarding is a fair question for a workspace SaaS like ClickUp, but the evidence pack never mentions a guided setup walkthrough, onboarding wizard, or first-time workspace tour. The Asana and Jira import tools are a related migration feature, not a guided walkthrough, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can follow a guided walkthrough to set up my workspace the first time
